CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  OR % 12.06.2024 CRL.M.A. 18284/2024 (Exemption)
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of accordingly.

3. The present application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. seeks anticipatory bail in case FIR No.
323/2024, under Sections 420 of the IPC and Section 12 of the Passport Act, registered at P.S. IGI Airport.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that the latter's name has come in the disclosure statement of the co-accused.
It is further pointed out that the applicant has already joined the investigation and is ready and willing to do the same in future.
